A movement born from one tenacious girl

Her name is Teagan.
Her fight became a movement.

Teagan was born with challenges most of us will never face - and has met every one of them with a tenacity that leaves you speechless. We turn that spirit into real help for children with special needs and the families who never stop fighting for them.

Why we exist

The fight is real.
So is the hope.

Families raising children with special needs carry a weight the world rarely sees - medical bills, equipment that costs more than a car, therapy, and the exhausting work of advocating for a child who deserves everything. We show up in the gap.

What care can cost
  • Gait trainer$0
  • Speech device (AAC)$0
  • Adaptive wheelchair$0
  • Therapy, one year$0
In a single year, one child$0

Typical out-of-pocket ranges for special-needs care. Every gift helps close the gap.

Equipment & access

Gait trainers, communication devices, adaptive gear, wheelchairs. The tools that turn "can't" into "watch me" are often out of reach. We help fund them.

Therapy & care

Physical, occupational, and speech therapy change lives - and add up fast. We help families keep going when the sessions, and the surgeries, are the difference.

Family & belonging

No family should fight alone. We build community, celebrate every milestone, and remind exhausted parents that their child - and their story - matters immensely.

Every step, her own 👑
The start
Meet Queen T
She was never supposed to do most of this. Then she went ahead and did it anyway.
Then

Born fighting, with a trach and a mountain of unknowns. Her family was handed a list of things she might never do.

The work

Graduated from her trach. Learned to eat. Took her first supported steps in a gait trainer - and kept going.

Her voice

She's nonverbal, so she found another way - telling her mom "more" and "want" with an eye-gaze device. Heard, loud and clear.

Now

12 years old, two little sisters, beep baseball, Kennywood days - and a walk across the room that gets stronger every single week.

Next

A very big, very scary spinal surgery ahead. She'll meet it the only way she knows how: tenaciously.

Twelve years, one fighter

This is what tenacity looks like.

Who we are

One uncle who couldn't look away.

Nate Richard

Founder · Teagan's uncle

Nate is a builder and founder from Pittsburgh who spends his days helping companies grow. Watching his niece Teagan fight for every inch changed what "impact" means to him - so he's putting the same relentless energy into getting families like hers the help they deserve.
